As at 31 August 2026 , there were 55,490,360 ordinary shares and 30,970,984 exchange shares in issue. As at 31 August 2026 the closing mid share price of an ordinary share in the Company was £1.38000 and represented a discount of 46.91% to the NAV per ordinary share.
